form.heading: Report an issue
form.description: Report inaccurate provider information to help us maintain the quality of the National Provider Directory. We may use this information to improve our data collection in the future.
form.errorHeading: This form contains the following errors
form.issuesLabel: What issue(s) do you want to report on this profile?
form.detailsLabel: Please provide details about the issue(s)
form.detailsHint: Describe what information is incorrect or outdated and what corrections should be made, if known
form.detailsOtherRequired: Specify and provide details about the issue
form.privacyBody: The information you provide will be used solely to improve the accuracy of the National Provider Directory. Your email will only be used to send you updates about this specific issue submission.
form.submitError: There was an error in submitting the form. Please try again.
form.successBody: Thank you for reporting an issue. We may use your submission to improve our data collection.
